item.title: Ava's Coaching Tip of the Day: Powerful Speech - Radio Update
item.description: The fastest way to add more power to performance is reducing or eliminating personal pronouns. Try it today. Take out all references to ‘I, me, we, us.’ I guarantee it will resonate! This is one of those ninja-level techniques that instantly elevates your content.

item.title: No-Cost Marketing – Doing More for Less - Radio Update
item.description: Welcome to the new management paradigm for radio: “We love marketing… just not the budget line.” When cuts come, marketing is often first on the chopping block. Yet here’s the irony: when revenue tightens, marketing matters more — not less.

item.title: What’s Possible When Small Market Radio Stations Prioritize Content - Radio Update
item.description: Back in the mid-1990s, when most of the radio industry was still trying to figure out what the internet was going to become, Johnny Boswell was thinking differently - looking past the novelty and to something more permanent. At the time, the prevailing attitude in broadcasting was that a website’s job was to provide listeners with an easy way to find the phone number.
